description: Iteration 2 bookkeeping record. Execution model: Claude Code agent teams execute every task (Agent calls + Workflow pipelines, worktree isolation for parallel phases); Forge provides deterministic validation gates, artifact bookkeeping, and forge verify. The Codex dispatch spawner is retired for this iteration. This graph is the planning/tracking record, not a dispatch input.
